decisions.reason: After two selling cycles this handle family remains in the firm's core architectural-hardware domain, so sunk development and launch investment plus strategic fit make management likely to continue it.

Its multifunctional positioning supports the firm's barrier-free and system-solution direction, encouraging management to justify the launch and treat any weaker uptake as temporary rather than exit now.
As a standard door lever family in an established competence area, it benefits from accumulated commitment and portfolio logic, which favors retention over reversal.
This collection has the strongest public commitment through its dedicated presentation and design-award signal, making withdrawal within the next year highly unlikely.
Although a finish option is easier to prune than a full family, it still supports the firm's design-led portfolio and management is likely to keep it unless rationalization pressure becomes clear.
